The passage describes a sacrifice where Purusa is divided, and from this sacrifice, various elements of the world and social classes (Brahman, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra) are created.  
It emphasizes the role of sacrifice in creation and ritual, which aligns with the importance of sacrifice (yajna) in Vedic religion.  
The text does not focus on faith alone, environmental stewardship, or karma and enlightenment.  

Final answer: (C)
